title: Astonischika
summary: Astonischika is a turn-based pixel role-playing game with a roguelite loop. Build a party from bold classes, climb a branching map and fight turn by turn against monsters, elites and bosses. Every run is different: you choose your path across battles, rest sites, treasure, merchants and minigames. When your party falls, the city remains your permanent home — your heroes, their gold and their gear grow from run to run. FEATURES • Build your party from a range of classes — warrior, mage, cleric, rogue, archer and more • Turn-based battles with skills, spells, elements and status effects • Branching map: battle, elite, boss, rest, treasure and merchant • Level-ups, attribute points, equipment and learnable spells • Minigames: shell game, dice, memory, coin flip and more • A permanent city hub — your progress stays after every run • Endless scaling for long-term motivation • 22 languages, music and sound effects GREAT FOR Quick battle rounds in between, or long dungeon sessions.

title: RedCoach
summary: Welcome to the RedCoach app — your all-in-one travel companion. Book affordable bus tickets, track your ride in real time, and earn rewards by joining RedCoach’s Loyalty Program. Top Features: • Search schedules and book bus trips for yourself, friends, or family • Track your bus in real time with live updates • Rebook or cancel trips with just a few taps • Access mobile tickets instantly for easy boarding • Select your seat and pay for extra baggage • Compare coach class amenities to pick your ride style • Save with promo codes and travel discounts • Join the Red Rider Loyalty Program and earn free trips • Manage your profile, trips, payments, and travel preferences • Reach out to customer support RedCoach puts smarter travel at your fingertips, delivering comfort, convenience, and complete control.

title: DelveKin: Dungeon Defense
summary: The heroes are coming. Build a dungeon worthy of stopping them! DelveKin is a charming dungeon defense strategy game where you take the role of the Dungeon Master. Design your defenses, place traps, command monsters, and battle invading heroes across handcrafted encounters and replay-able dungeon challenges. BUILD YOUR DUNGEON - Choose rooms with different layouts and tactical advantages, then fill them with monsters and traps. Every placement matters as heroes advance deeper into your dungeon. COMMAND YOUR MONSTERS - Take direct control during turn-based battles. Move across the battlefield, launch basic attacks, unleash special abilities, and combine your monsters' strengths to overcome each group of heroes. SET CLEVER TRAPS - Slow heroes with snares, strike from the walls with arrow slits, or punish careless movement with hidden hazards. Traps can shape the battlefield and create opportunities for your monsters. GROW YOUR ARSENAL - Unlock new monsters, traps, rooms, and powerful bosses as you progress. Earn experience, level up your defenses, and build stronger dungeon teams for the challenges ahead. FACE NEW HEROES - Each stage introduces different hero combinations, abilities, and tactical threats. Adapt your dungeon to withstand knights, mages, rogues, clerics, and other determined adventurers. VENTURE INTO DEEP DELVE - Put your dungeon building skills to the ultimate test in Deep Delve, a replay-able 20-depth challenge where every run is different. Build a run specific roster, recruit and replace monsters and traps, choose powerful upgrades, evolve your boss, and see how deep your dungeon can survive. CONTINUE INTO DUNGEON RAIDS - Complete the main campaign and enter Dungeon Raids, where increasingly dangerous hero parties push your defenses even further. CHARMING ART STYLE - DelveKin features expressive characters, lively battle animations, and a playful fantasy world. Play the opening chapters for free. A single Premium unlock opens the full campaign, additional progression, Dungeon Raids, and Deep Delve. Build carefully. Fight cleverly. Protect your dungeon.

title: Word Tack
summary: Sort scattered words into their hidden groups in Word Tack, a cozy word puzzle with a handmade feel: washi tape, typewriter labels and paper tiles that look cut out by hand. Every puzzle hides eight groups of five words. Drag tiles between rows, and when a row holds all five words of a group, it's sealed and its category is revealed. There's no timer and no penalty for a wrong guess, so take your time. PLAY YOUR WAY • A growing campaign of handcrafted levels, from everyday categories to clever wordplay and real head-scratchers, with more added in updates • Every level is marked easy, medium or hard • A Daily Puzzle to play each day, with shareable emoji results and a streak to keep GENTLE HELP WHEN YOU'RE STUCK • Inklings link two words from the same group • Clues reveal the names of up to three groups • Solve a puzzle without help to earn all three stars MAKE THE DESK YOUR OWN • Earn stamps as you play • Spend them in the shop on washi tape, tile styles, row seals, desk backgrounds and confetti, including dazzling gold and holographic finishes MADE WITH CARE • Satisfying sounds, gentle haptics and a soft soundtrack, each with its own setting • Statistics, star ratings and daily streaks to track your progress • Works with VoiceOver: hear when rows are solved and where each tile sits on the board • A Reduce Motion setting for calmer play • No ads, no in-app purchases and no account needed. Works offline.

title: ArcFlush: Roguelike Solitaire
summary: Cards don't line up politely here. They're stacked in layers — the way mahjong tiles are stacked, except these are playing cards, and one of the maps is on fire. Which means there are two games sitting on top of each other: getting a card out of the pile, and knowing what to do with it once you have it. HOW IT WORKS · The map is a layered formation. Anything underneath is locked until you clear what's covering it, so every card you take decides what you're allowed to take next. That half is solitaire. · Play up to five of the cards you've taken as a poker hand. A pair is fine. A Flush is better. A Straight Flush means you planned ahead — or got lucky and will claim you planned ahead. That half is poker. · Beat the stage's target score, spend what you earned in the Shop, and do it again. And again. Until the target has grown a couple of digits and you're no longer certain which of your trinkets is doing the heavy lifting. WHAT'S IN IT · Every map is built around exactly one idea. Ice Lake freezes cards. Furnace sets them alight. Dark Pool turns the lights off and invites you to feel your way out. · Clear a map and its Twist unlocks: the same map, in a considerably worse mood. · Trinkets. Some add points. Some quietly rewrite a rule you'd assumed was permanent. The legendary ones turn up rarely enough that finding the right one feels like the run has decided to help you, just this once. · A Shop between stages, because a roguelite without a shop is just a difficult puzzle. · A tutorial that leaves quickly and waits in Settings in case you ever want it back. WHAT'S NOT IN IT · Ads. · In-app purchases. · A season pass, a battle pass, or a little bar that refills while you sleep. · An internet connection. This app has never phoned home and wouldn't know who to call. Buy it once and own all of it — every map, every trinket, every Twist. There is nothing else to sell you, and we are not going to think of anything. One deck, thirteen languages. Good luck.

title: Quintra
summary: Quintra brings poker hands to a shared board. Place cards to build pairs, straights, flushes, and more across rows and columns. Connect with cards already in play, find the right opening, and turn one card into points in two directions. ONE BOARD. SO MANY POSSIBILITIES. Build on what's there, line up bonus spaces, and watch for opportunities where hands cross. Your best move could also give your opponent something to work with. PLAY FRIENDS AT YOUR PACE Trade turns through Game Center whenever you're ready. Match Play spans two rounds with the same deal and swapped seats, giving both players a chance to make the most of each hand. A FRESH PUZZLE EVERY DAY Fit the cards to match every marked poker hand. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard, then see how your completion time stacks up on the daily puzzle leaderboards. EIGHT TURNS. MAKE EACH ONE COUNT. Take on the Daily Challenge: a daily deal, eight solo turns, and a leaderboard to climb. Find the connections that turn a good score into a great one. PLAY SOLO Learn the board in Practice or take on the computer in Match Play. Choose your difficulty and try new approaches at your own pace. MAKE IT YOURS Earn XP, level up, and chase goals and achievements as you play. Unlock new card decks and board looks to make Quintra feel like yours. Every poker hand changes the game.

title: SortFlow
summary: SortFlow is a relaxing water-sort puzzle. Pour colored liquids between tubes until each tube holds a single color. • Four ways to play: Standard, Classic (the traditional rules), Time Attack and Zen • Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles across eight difficulty tiers, up to Legendary • A new Daily Challenge every day, with streaks and trophy celebrations • Weekly Leagues: earn XP in any mode, climb from Bronze to Diamond, and claim coins every Monday • Leaderboards in the app for every mode and difficulty, Global or Friends, plus Game Center achievements • Daily and weekly quests with coins to claim • Challenge a friend: share a puzzle and see who scores higher on the same board • Level up, earn coins, and unlock themes, tube skins, sound packs and win celebrations • Leave any puzzle and resume right where you left off — all modes save automatically • Build combo streaks with a burning combo counter and sound effects • Play offline, anytime No pressure, no clutter — just satisfying, colorful logic.

Enjoy live TV, catch up on demand, or download shows and films to watch later. With a refreshed design and improved ways to find and watch content, this latest version delivers a more streamlined and personalised viewing experience across mobile and tablet devices. In this release, you can enjoy: A new interface aligned with the Sky Glass and Sky Stream experience. Streaming across Live TV, On Demand, Sky Sports events and Downloads. A redesigned browse experience with improved TV Guide and Search functionality. Personalised recommendations to help you discover more of the content you love. Seamless viewing across your compatible Sky devices at home.

title: Ringbloom: The Garden Puzzle
summary: Rotate a ring. Align matching petals. Watch the garden bloom. Ringbloom is a calm rotational puzzle with a simple choice behind every move: select the inner, middle or outer ring, then turn it left or right. Align matching petals across a spoke, make a bloom and keep your garden growing before your moves run out. TWO WAYS TO PLAY • Garden — an endless, steadily growing puzzle for a quick break or a longer run. • Flower Show — focused Classes with fresh objectives and new ways to think about each turn. Start free with endless Garden and the first five Flower Show Classes. When you want a bigger challenge, one permanent purchase unlocks 25 more campaign Classes and the Champion Circuit. There is no subscription, energy system or advertising. Build bloom chains, chase stronger results and replay Classes to improve your rating. Clear objectives arrive as you play, with labelled controls, Undo and Hint support when you need a hand. Ringbloom is designed for one-thumb play, with distinct glyphs alongside colour, VoiceOver support, Larger Text layouts and Reduce Motion support. Gameplay works offline and progress is kept on your device. Ringbloom began as an AI app-building benchmark and has been refined through play and testing. Ringbloom uses limited analytics and advertising attribution. No account is required. See the privacy policy for the information used and the choices available.

title: Nail Sort: Polish Puzzle
summary: Pour, sort and collect. Nail Sort is a relaxing color puzzle where you organize polish bottles until each one holds a single shade. HOW TO PLAY Tap a bottle to pick up the top layer, then tap another bottle to pour it. Colors only stack on matching colors. Clear the level when every bottle holds one pure shade. Easy to learn, hard to put down. BUILD YOUR COLLECTION Every level you finish paints a nail in your collection. Complete full seasonal sets: Coral, Nude, Midnight Blue, Rose Gold, Emerald and many more. NO RUSH, NO PRESSURE No timers. No lives to wait for. No scores to chase. Play one level while your coffee brews, or lose an hour to it. Your call. FEATURES - Hundreds of levels with a smooth difficulty curve - 12 polish shades to collect - Unlimited undo while you think - Extra bottles when you get stuck - Plays fully offline - Clean, elegant design with no visual noise Perfect for unwinding, relaxing and giving your mind a break. Download Nail Sort and start your collection.
